functional_correctness.description: The solution correctly implements the functionality as per the user's requirements, producing expected outputs for given inputs.

bug_sensitivity.description: The extent to which the code handles subtle bugs or edge cases that may arise during execution.

engineering_quality.description: The overall quality of the code including structure, adherence to best practices, and use of efficient algorithms.

efficiency.description: The time and space complexity of the solution, particularly whether it meets the required complexities.

robustness.description: The ability of the code to handle unexpected inputs or edge cases without failing.

api_library_usage.description: The correct and optimal use of APIs or libraries, where applicable, without unnecessary complexity.

readability.description: The clarity and maintainability of the code, including naming conventions and comments.

error_handling.description: The implementation of error handling mechanisms to manage exceptions and ensure security against common vulnerabilities.
